:::{#exm-set-builder-expression}
#### Squaring die rolls
<!-- no-figure: a few written sets; nothing to plot -->

Squaring each possible roll of a six-sided die gives the [set](#def-set)

$$\set{x^2 : x \in \set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}} = \set{1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36},$$

written in [set-builder notation with an expression](#def-set-builder-expression).
Two choices of $x$ can give the same $x^2$,
and that object is then one element of the set:
$\set{x^2 : x \in \set{-2, -1, 0, 1, 2}} = \set{0, 1, 4}$,
since $(-2)^2 = 2^2$ and $(-1)^2 = 1^2$.

:::
